details:
* OpenJDK 17.0.21.1 release, build 2, built from the jdk-17.0.21.1+2
     (= jdk-17.0.21.1-ga) tag of the upstream jdk17u repository; the orig
     tarball is produced as by 'debian/rules get-orig'.
     - Security fixes: CVE-2026-114938, CVE-2026-114939, CVE-2026-114940,
       CVE-2026-114942, CVE-2026-114943, CVE-2026-114944, CVE-2026-114945,
       CVE-2026-114946.
     - OpenJDK vulnerability advisory:
       https://openjdk.org/groups/vulnerability/advisories/2026-11-17
   * Also picks up all OpenJDK 17 updates from 17.0.8 to 17.0.21.0.3 (July
     2023 to October 2026 CPUs), which this branch had not been rebased to
     yet. Bundled timezone data is now tzdata2026f.
   * CVEs fixed by the OpenJDK 17 releases between 17.0.7 and 17.0.21.0.3,
     which this update includes (per the OpenJDK vulnerability advisories):
